reasons: Cited clause specifies internal laws of the State of New York and exclusive jurisdiction of the SDNY or New York State courts in the City of New York, matching the preferred position (NY law, exclusive NY state and federal courts).
No arbitration provision is present, so no foreign-seat walk-away concern; deterministic check confirms jurisdiction is within the accepted set.

Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is identical to the original and no counterparty comment was raised; the 'City of New York' vs 'New York County' variance is correctly noted as non-material rather than redlined.
